errors.text: The disappearance of small particles is attributed primarily to Ostwald ripening and redeposition, whereas the target mechanism emphasizes Au/Cu surface segregation followed by melting and evaporation.
The predicted shape evolution from spherical to faceted or irregular particles conflicts with the observed elliptical-to-spherical transition.
The claimed >50 nm boundary for sluggish diffusion is unsupported and misses the experimentally relevant temperature boundary near 673 K.
The cited evidence concerns unrelated bulk high-entropy alloys and does not validate diffusion, segregation, or evaporation in AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticles.
